changes: Removed user-readable koala branding from active source/scripts/docs across 272 files in 6 batches (lab, docs/utils, scripts, main-src core+top, main-src handlers/tasks/verifier, test smoke/fixtures), preserving documented exceptions (process-lane names, .koala runtime paths, signature salts, legacy-detection logic, test-assertion fixtures). Added a committed canonical gate scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs.
usage: Run `node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs` to check active-scope koala-brand residue (PASS = 0 unclassified); `node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs --self-test` runs 5 classify() unit tests covering boundary cases.
expectedOutcome: git grep -i koala over active scope leaves only documented exceptions; lattice validate / build / e2e all green; verify-koala-residue PASS exit 0.
actualTranscript: node scripts/verify-koala-residue.mjs -> PASS koala-residue: 0 unclassified; --self-test -> 5/5; lattice validate -> ALL PASS; npm run build -> exit 0; npm run test:e2e -> all pass; node bin/lattice.js verify_codex -> 8/8.
outcomeDiff: none - expected matches actual; all gates green.
limitations: Process-lane names, .koala runtime paths, salts and legacy-detection logic are kept as documented exceptions; 3 residual .Codex/agents refs in packages/main (prompt-registry-smoke.ts, product-reviewer.json fixture) are pre-existing/out-of-scope; the gate is not yet wired into the lattice validate battery (deferred to story 4).
pitfalls: verify-koala-residue scope is git-tracked/staged files only, so an untracked new file is not scanned until git add; the file-level allowlist must be refined when story 4 extends the gate, to avoid masking new brand text inside legacy-logic-allowlisted files.
